In [[3674 BBY]], during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''battle''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bomodon]]. During a flight over the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world, a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] carrying a [[Elin Garza's platoon|platoon]] of [[Republic soldier]]s from the [[Republic Army|Army's]] [[45th Infantry Division]] was shot down. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Elin Garza]], the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon's]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], proceeded to lead her surviving forces in a guerrilla campaign against the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] units on the planet. Aided by the embedded [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Spy/Legends|agent]] [[Marcus Trant]], Garza and her [[Troop/Legends|troops]] eventually succeeded in liberating Bomodon, achieving an unlikely and uncommon victory for the Republic.

==Prelude==
The [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that began in [[3681 BBY]] commenced in a severely negative fashion for the Republic. At the outset, huge swaths of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] were conquered by the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] while the Republic floundered in crises and debate. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] strategy at this time was primarily focused on domination of the Outer Rim,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> although two instances stand of Imperial activity in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] in these early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the war. The first was the [[Battle of Talay]], wherein naval [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Broysc]] led his forces into a Republic rout.<ref name="Incompetent">{{TORcite|type=conversation|Malavai Quinn|Incompetent}}</ref> The second was the Empire's acquisition of [[Bomodon]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]] of the Mid Rim.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> In [[3674 BBY]], the Republic challenged the Imperial claim to Bomodon, sparking a battle for control of the planet.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==The battle==
The [[Standard month/Legends|months]]-long contest for Bomodon was notable for the participation of [[Elin Garza]] and [[Marcus Trant]]. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Garza, a [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] from the [[Republic Army]]'s [[45th Infantry Division]], was with her unit when their [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] was shot down in flight over the planet. She and her surviving [[Troop/Legends|troops]] were able to evade capture by Imperial forces through the assistance of Trant, an embedded [[Spy/Legends|agent]] from the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. With Trant's assistance, Garza and her platoon waged a guerrilla war against the Imperial occupation; the ten-month campaign ultimately ended with the Republic forces driving the Empire off Bomodon.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Aftermath==
The loss of the planet eventually led to the Empire's [[Third battle of the Seswenna sector|seizure]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] and its third and most significant attempt at penetrating the Mid Rim in the [[First Battle of Bothawui]].<ref name="Timeline 5" /> After their victory on Bomodon, Garza and Trant [[Marriage/Legends|married]], though their relationship lasted only twenty-six months. Garza's exploits ultimately earned her the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] and Trant's successes ferried him to the position of [[Director of Republic Strategic Information Service|Director]] of the Republic Strategic Information Service.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle on Bomodon was first mentioned in the entries for Marcus Trant and Elin Garza in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
